# Boundary percentages select no rows or the whole table, respectively.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/table-sampling.md

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (0 PERCENT)
=> "0"

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (100 PERCENT)
=> "4"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT a FROM t TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (100.0 PERCENT) ORDER BY a))
=> "[null,1,2,3]"

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (0.0 PERCENT)
=> "0"

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (-1 PERCENT)
=> error:

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (101 PERCENT)
=> error:

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (-0.1 PERCENT)
=> error:

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (100.1 PERCENT)
=> error:

# BigQuery's TABLESAMPLE syntax does not include REPEATABLE.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/query-syntax.md
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (50 PERCENT) REPEATABLE (42)
=> error:

# EXECUTE IMMEDIATE passes USING values as query parameters.
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scalars.t TABLESAMPLE SYSTEM (@percent PERCENT)' USING 100 AS percent
=> "4"
